sm: President Trump defended his relationships with the leaders of China and Russia after returning from a trip, saying a roughly ninety minute talk with them covered nuclear weapons and artificial intelligence, though he gave few specifics. Critics from both parties pushed back on his warm words for Vladimir Putin. The newscast also reported that the national cyber director is stepping down, with the Pentagon's chief information officer expected to replace him, after a week of outages at the National Security Agency, banks and airlines that officials tied to software updates and not a cyberattack. Other stories covered the death of Fiona the hippo at the Cincinnati Zoo, and recalls of more than three hundred thousand Toyota and Lexus vehicles for faulty airbags.
